corpus_note: Corpus: 56 incidents captured from the live stack (7 fault families x 8 variations). Baseline: `rules-v1`. Repeats for nondeterministic variants: 3.

power_note.text: With 56 paired scenarios and 32% discordant pairs, a difference in cause accuracy smaller than about 21% would usually go undetected (80% power, alpha 0.05).
